label: ornithine decarboxylase activity
definition: A phenotype in which a microorganism produces active ornithine decarboxylase enzymes that decarboxylate L-ornithine to putrescine and carbon dioxide.
observations: Follow-up from the physiology diagnostic-enzyme gap sweep; absent from METPO and TraitMech after an ornithine decarboxylase duplicate review covering ignored and hidden files.
